findings.title: TierBoardPage.tsx at 456 LOC — god-component further reduced, carried forward

All remaining handlers require modal state context or multi-selector reads.

builder_notes.pattern: Partial extraction opportunity in large page shells
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Page has 8+ useCallback hooks; sorting by dependency reveals a clean dispatch-only subset and a messier modal-state-coupled subset
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Group handlers by closure over local modal state vs. only dispatch; the dispatch-only group extracts cleanly; modal-coupled stays
builder_notes.stack_example: handleFileDrop, handleItemMediaDrop, handleItemClick in TierBoardPage shared only dispatch; extracted to useItemInteraction.ts (loop 12). handleItemDoubleClick (body: setEditingItem(item)) stayed in page.

builder_notes.pattern: Batch operation handlers sharing a selector
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Two useCallback handlers both read selection from store AND both dispatch to same concern (batch move / batch delete)
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Extract both to a hook that reads selection internally via useAppSelector; the hook takes only dispatch
builder_notes.stack_example: handleBatchMoveToTier and handleBatchDelete in TierBoardPage both check selection.length === 0 — same guard, same selector dependency

builder_notes.pattern: Extraction earns its keep when 3+ handlers share the same dependency
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: If only 1-2 handlers would move, the new hook Interface is nearly as wide as its Implementation (shallow module test triggers)
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Require >= 3 related handlers OR >= 2 handlers with substantial logic per handler before extracting a custom hook. Single-line handlers stay inline.
builder_notes.stack_example: handleItemDoubleClick has 1-line body; its extraction would be a costume layer. useItemInteraction has 3 handlers each with 10-20 lines — earns its keep.

narrative: Good app, place but not win. Loop 12 executes the useItemInteraction extraction that loops 10-11 evaluated. TierBoardPage 507→456 LOC; 3 dispatch-only handlers now behind a stable Interface with 7 tests. architecture_quality 6.5→7.0; simplicity 6.0→6.5. Both moves honest: structural proof is the new hook plus removed handlers in the diff. Remaining backlog: F-004 still open (further reduction requires useBatchActions extraction or modal state co-extraction — both more complex). Page shells across the app lack Interface Depth at the page level; useItemInteraction is local progress.
